scope: Read-only source review of reachable Compose screens and implementation; no device behavior or Google Play publication verification.

evidence.feature: Version and minimum Android
Reachable screens
Initial country selection and optional download
Dashboard, search, favorites and adding holdings
Holding creation, editing, deletion and TRY portfolio totals
Asset graph, indicators and fundamentals
Scanner scores, comparison and sector summaries
Valuation and health scores; not external generative AI
conditions: Health metrics are simplified implementations, not independently certified financial assessments

evidence.feature: Modeling choices, model error metrics and stress scenarios
conditions: No external generative AI key required

evidence.feature: Backtest rules, capital, trade log and risk metrics
conditions: Historical simulation only; no real order execution

evidence.feature: Monte Carlo horizons and simulation counts
Portfolio optimization weights, targets and frontier
Configurable streaming AI chat and limited unconfigured demo
conditions: Network and configured provider for full chat

evidence.feature: AI request data flow
conditions: Messages and generated context sent to selected provider
Context can contain holding symbols, quantities, costs and favorites
API key is transmitted to provider for authentication

evidence.feature: Voice mascot, mute and text answer
conditions: Configured AI provider for full voice chat
Recognition and preferred network TTS may involve external services

evidence.feature: Widget menu, voice overlay, portfolio status and moods
RSS news, news impact and historical replay
conditions: Configured external AI provider for news impact

evidence.feature: Analysis rights and advertising
conditions: Rewarded ad resets to 20; not additive +20

evidence.feature: Settings, optional Google sign-in, language, source selection and notification controls
conditions: Third-party premium data subscription is not an OPS app subscription

evidence.feature: Storage security and backup limits
conditions: Encrypted preferences attempted, plaintext fallback exists
Database and key preferences excluded from configured Android backup/transfer
